title: Yannai, son of Rabbi Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Chullin 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.111a.1-2), Rabbi Zerika said to Rav Safra, “Yannai, son of Rabbi Ami, and I came to the house of Yehudah, son of Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi,” etc.

notes.text: The exchange starts on [Chullin 110b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.110b.4-6). Abaye sends Safra to ask about cooking liver. At Safra’s second visit, Zerika recalls eating with Yannai at Yehudah’s house.
The first visit on 110b calls the speaker Rav Zerika, while the second visit on 111a calls him Rabbi Zerika.

The printed notice spans both columns of Hyman’s p. 765. In Chullin 110b, Rav Safra visits Zerika, returns to Abaye, and receives a clarification. Chullin 111a continues that exchange before Safra’s second visit, when Zerika recounts the visit with Yannai. This sequence supports Hyman’s attribution of the reply to Zerika.
